verdict.rationale: Helicone publishes a documented REST API with a hosted endpoint, for example POST https://api.helicone.ai/v1/request/query for querying requests. It also serves an OpenAPI spec (swagger.json) and an OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway API, so the product can be driven programmatically. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage beyond request querying (e.g., managing prompts, sessions, alerts or webhooks via API), independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic control

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json — contains "openapi" key
